changes.to: Maker page: 5 ft 9 in (about 175.3 cm), about 60 kg, 38 DoF, in-house full-stack proprietary actuators, tendon-driven high-payload manipulators, structure, actuators, manipulators and software all built in-house; first industrial beta deployments planned for 2027 from a beta sign-up list.
